newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly weaker.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly weaker on Thursday, traders said.
Spot and paper naphtha prices remained easy in early trade with discussion very thin as buyers stayed scarce.
Prompt gasoline barge prices were weaker, pressured by hedge related selling, while the market's short term contango steadied cargo prices.
Heating oil premiums were steady, with outright prices narrowly lower on easier futures. Diesel looked a touch pressured, but supplies were still tightish.
High sulphur fuel oil barge trade was slow.
Offers were $82 fob, with prompt bids at $80.
